prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a small transparent animated icon on a fashion workflow website
Primary request: Create one square image containing EXACTLY four equal square panels in a precise 2 by 2 arrangement. The four panels show successive tiny motion phases of the SAME subject: a premium miniature white-clay fashion technical drawing of a tailored jacket on a drafting surface, with a slim measuring ruler beside it and a small ruler marker sliding along the jacket's side seam. Panel 1: ruler marker at the top, jacket at rest. Panel 2: marker starts sliding down. Panel 3: marker reaches the lower hem, a delicate measurement line aligns along the jacket. Panel 4: marker returns toward the top. This should be clearly about measuring a jacket during technical design.
Scene/backdrop: no environment beyond the object; transparent background.
Subject: one centered jacket technical drawing and one ruler, repeated exactly in all four panels.
Style/medium: charming premium softly rounded white-clay/paper 3D miniature icon, tactile matte white surfaces, subtle pale neutral-grey dimensional shading, refined hand-crafted fashion illustration, sophisticated, friendly, soft studio light.
Composition/framing: each tile is a separate identical square crop, same fixed camera, identical objects, shape, scale, position, lighting and ample transparent margin; arrange exactly top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Keep the entire object inside each tile. No perspective or camera movement.
Lighting/mood: gentle studio illumination with clean soft dimensional shading.
Color palette: white and pale neutral grey only; transparent alpha around the objects.
Materials/textures: softly rounded matte porcelain-like clay and fine paper surface, gentle tactile relief.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: EXACTLY four successive motion phases, same subject and framing repeated across four tiles; no extra subject; transparent background with clean alpha; preserve ample transparent margins around every tile.
Avoid: vector or crude line art, colors, beige, black backgrounds, text, labels, numbers, watermark, grid lines, panel borders, dividers, contact sheet frame, cropped objects, different designs between panels. The 2x2 layout is only the four panels; no visible tile outlines or gaps.
